9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: With your presidency behind you, you set out to begin your new life in Benfi. You moved into...

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text:
Your new home had everything your heart desired. You loved waking up and falling asleep to the sound of the waves.

You couldn't stay idle for long, though. You...

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text:
It was a far cry from the luxury you'd enjoyed in Holsord, but you loved waking up to the sound of the waves.

You couldn't stay idle for long, though. You...

12.speaker: Player
12.text: ...became an adjunct professor of politics at Benfi University.

22.speaker: Player
22.text: ...called up Petr and hit the clubs.

23.speaker: Player
23.text: You never heard from either of them ever again.
